description: NixOS Package PRs for lvm2-2.03.21, setxkbmap, khotkeys-5.27.5, kmenuedit, bluedevil, nano-7.2 packages on GitHub

items.content_html:
Changelog: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/app/setxkbmap/-/compare/setxkbmap-1.3.4...setxkbmap-1.3.5

  • Build with meson, as the old TODO asked. Upstream ships meson.build; the output (bin/setxkbmap, share/man/man1/setxkbmap.1.gz) is the same as before, and the XKB config root still points to xkeyboard-config.
  • Targets staging: this causes about 10791 rebuilds (libxkbcommon depends on setxkbmap).

Tests (x86_64-linux, on master): built setxkbmap, libxkbcommon_8 (with its tests) and i3; ran setxkbmap -version, setxkbmap -layout de -print and setxkbmap -query on Xvfb. A full nixpkgs-review was not possible because of the rebuild size.

AI disclosure: this change and this description were prepared with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5). I reviewed the diff and the build results before I opened this PR.

Things done

  • Fits CONTRIBUTING.md, pkgs/README.md, maintainers/README.md and other READMEs.
  • Follows the automation/AI policy.
  • Built on platform:
    • x86_64-linux
    • aarch64-linux
    • aarch64-darwin
  • Tested, as applicable:
    • Basic functionality of all binary files, usually in ./result/bin/.
    • Ran nixpkgs-review on this PR. See nixpkgs-review usage.
    • Package tests at passthru.tests.
    • NixOS tests in nixos/tests.
    • Tests in lib/tests or pkgs/test for functions and "core" functionality.
  • Nixpkgs Release Notes
    • Package update: when the change is major or breaking.
  • NixOS Release Notes
    • Module addition: when adding a new NixOS module.
    • Module update: when the change is significant.
